scope: Five Canadian-market 2026 compact SUV configurations across three models; dated specification and base MSRP snapshot.
pricingNote: Base MSRP in CAD excludes freight/PDI, levies, taxes, registration, dealer fees, options and accessories. Announcement prices may have changed; this is not an on-road quote.
